facility.name: Childtime Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8100 MILLER RD, ROWLETT, TX, 75088

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: A four-year-old child was left unsupervised in a classroom for five minutes.  The children were entering the building from outdoors and went into another classroom instead of the grouping room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The gas leak inspection was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: During an investigation it was observed (through video footage) that children were observed sitting for a prolonged period of time after they ate and the caregiver was cleaning up from lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver failed to use good judgment when the following actions were observed on video footage: a child was tapped on the head with a computer tablet, and soapy water was sprayed on the table where the children were sitting, causing the water to splash onto their faces and bodies. Additionally, the caregiver failed to inform the director when a parent raised concerns about inappropriate discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During an investigation it was observed (through video footage) that a caregiver was pinching children.    During an investigation it was discovered through video footage the following:  A caregiver is observed pulling children, pushing a child into the table and kicking the chair that a child is sitting in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: The high chairs did not have straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Two classrooms did not have a daily schedule.  The school age schedule had not been updated to reflect summer schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram: Three classrooms did not have the evacuation plan posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram (26 TAC §746.5207(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: Two classrooms had fans on shelves that children had access to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The pre-k classroom did not have an accurate count and documentation of all the children in care.      The  transition roster was updated during a name to face check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The operation remains out of compliance due to the pre-k teacher not maintaining an account of all the children they are responsible for during transition and not maintaining audio or visual awareness after lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Two toddler children were able to go outside to the playground area unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver grabbed a child inappropriately resulting in bruise under the child's arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The build had been without a.c in the schooler's area and several classrooms.      Several work orders were completed and temporary a.c.units were put in place until the a.c was fixed on 07/10/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Storage: The operation was unable to locate a child's folder.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Storage (26 TAC §746.603(b))

occurrences.finding: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence: A caregiver brought a gun on premises.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Firearms, Hunting Knives, Bows and Arrows, Weapons Prohibited Unless Residence (26 TAC §746.3707(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing: One caregiver was caring for twenty-five children during opening time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Opening/Closing (26 TAC §746.1615)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Five children under the age of eighteen months were present in the classroom with children older than eighteen months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The operation did not have a current inspection posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants in care did not have updated infant feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Caregivers were allowed to be in classroom without CPR training unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The governing body has not complied with maintaining staff and or training staff to care for child effectively.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The school-age restroom had a strong smell of urine. The  floor had an unknown substance and the sink were not cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: According to logs, the operation has been out of ratio in several classes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: A child was injurred in care and the parent did not recieve an incident report and not notified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The slide use zone did not have properly maintained loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Upon review of a video, a teacher is seen grabbing a child inappropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two infants did not have updated feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver did not intervine after an altercation between students.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Caregivers responsible for children under the age of 24 months did not have current infant trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not exercise good judgment when they fed an infant table food and did not adhere to the feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: The operation did not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report: The operation did not have a current gas test on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Fire Inspection Report, Including Written Approval for Above/Below Ground Level Care (26 TAC §746.801(11))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation did not have relocation address for the emergency preparedness plan.        The operation added a relocation address and sent email to parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The playground was not maintained to the required nine inch depth for loose fill.       The operation was able to rake loose fill to required depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: After review of records, several children did not have immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, 2 of them did not have the health statement as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))
